title: Reverse Linked List
description:
Given the `head` of a singly linked list, reverse the list and return the new head.

In the test data a list is written as an array of its values, so `[1,2,3]` is `1 -> 2 -> 3` and `[]` is an empty list (`null`).
hints: Walk the list while keeping a pointer to the previous node; point each node back at it.
Remember to save `next` before you overwrite it. A recursive solution is also possible.
